steps.instruction: Run `npm init @vitejs/app` in the terminal, set a project name, select the `vanilla` framework, and choose `JavaScript`.

steps.instruction: Install Three.js by running `npm install three` in the project directory.
steps.today: Three.js continues to be installed via npm using `npm install three`.

steps.instruction: Open `index.html` and add `<canvas id="bg"></canvas>` inside the `<body>` preceding the script tag.
steps.today: Adding a `<canvas id="bg"></canvas>` inside the `<body>` before the script tag remains valid HTML for providing a target rendering element.

steps.instruction: Open `style.css` and style `canvas` with `position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0;`.
steps.today: Setting `canvas { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; }` remains standard CSS for positioning the Three.js canvas across the viewport background.

steps.instruction: In `main.js`, import Three.js and initialize the Scene, PerspectiveCamera, and WebGLRenderer bound to the `#bg` canvas.
steps.today: Initializing a Scene, PerspectiveCamera, and WebGLRenderer configured with a canvas selector like `#bg` remains standard Three.js setup.

steps.instruction: Create a Torus geometry and material, combine them into a `THREE.Mesh`, and add the mesh to the scene.
steps.today: Creating a TorusGeometry and a Material, combining them into a Mesh, and adding that mesh to the Scene works exactly as described.

steps.instruction: Set up a game loop by defining an `animate` function that calls `requestAnimationFrame(animate)` and re-renders the scene.
steps.today: Setting up an animation loop using `requestAnimationFrame(animate)` to update and re-render the scene remains fully supported and widely used.

steps.instruction: Add a `PointLight` and an `AmbientLight` to illuminate the 3D objects across the scene.
steps.today: Adding `PointLight` and `AmbientLight` instances to illuminate objects in the scene continues to function as written.

steps.instruction: Import `OrbitControls` from `three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls` and instantiate it with the camera and renderer DOM element.

steps.today: `THREE.MathUtils.randFloatSpread` remains the standard utility method for generating random float values evenly distributed across a specified spread.

steps.instruction: Load space and celestial body images using `THREE.TextureLoader().load()` to set background and object textures.
steps.today: Instantiating `new THREE.TextureLoader().load()` is still the official way to load image textures and assign them to scene backgrounds or material maps.

steps.instruction: Create a `moveCamera` function mapped to `document.body.onscroll` to recalculate scroll offset and update camera and object positions.
steps.today: Binding a `moveCamera` function to `document.body.onscroll` to read window scroll values and update Three.js camera and mesh coordinates is standard browser DOM behavior and continues to work.

steps.today: You are still prompted on the initial setup screen to enter your legal first name, legal surname, date of birth, and country before tapping Next.

steps.instruction: Select your Business type as Individual/sole proprietor/single-member LLC and tap Next.
steps.today: Selecting Individual/sole proprietor/single-member LLC remains the standard business type option before tapping Next.

steps.instruction: Fill in your Primary address details, phone number, email address, Permanent account number (PAN), check the certification box, and tap Next.
steps.today: Entering your primary address, contact details, tax identification number (such as PAN for India), and checking the certification box remains the active form step before continuing.

steps.instruction: Select Bank transfer as your payout method, enter your bank IFSC code and Bank account number, and tap Link payout method.
steps.today: Select Bank transfer (or manually link bank account) to input your bank details, including IFSC code and account number for eligible regions, and click Link payout method.

steps.instruction: Tap Add tax info and proceed by tapping Continue as [Your Name].
steps.today: Click Add tax info and proceed through the authorization prompt by clicking Continue as [Your Name].

steps.instruction: Select No for both US citizen status and intermediary agent questions, then tap Next.
steps.today: Answer No to being a US citizen/resident and No to acting as an intermediary agent, then click Next.

steps.instruction: Select your Country of citizenship, verify or enter your PAN number in Non-US TIN, and tap Next.
steps.today: Choose your Country of citizenship, verify or provide your tax identification number (such as PAN for India) under Non-US TIN, and click Next.

steps.instruction: Confirm your address and mailing address settings by tapping Next through the address confirmation screens.
steps.today: Review and confirm your permanent address and mailing address details, then proceed by tapping Next.

steps.instruction: Select 0% of services will be physically performed inside the United States, then tap Next.
steps.today: Select "0% of services will be physically performed inside the United States" and tap Next to continue your tax profile setup.

steps.instruction: Select your Country for tax treaty benefits and tap Next.
steps.today: Select your country of residence to determine eligibility for tax treaty benefits and tap Next.

steps.instruction: Check the consent box, type your full name in the Signature field, tap Next, then tap Submit Form and finish with Done.
steps.today: Check the electronic signature consent box, enter your full legal name in the Signature field, tap Next to review your W-8BEN form, and finish by tapping Submit Form and Done.
